name: Clayton McDuffie
source:
The son of the South Virginia governor who has an obsessive crush on Marco, and Henrietta’s last boyfriend before he died. He cannot let go of the past and he keeps Marco grounded in this world. He is ruthlessly picked on by Kieran for his attraction to men.

[From [url=https://tabbykatz.itch.io/under-the-dogwood-tree]official profile[/url]]
